title: Funny Face Toddler in Vintage Taylor-Tot Walker, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A classic mid-century black-and-white deckle-edge snapshot capturing a young toddler with a grumpy, squinting expression seated in a vintage metal Taylor-Tot baby walker stroller. The child is positioned outside in a dirt yard beside a concrete walkway in front of a house clad in rustic wood shingles and wooden lattice skirting. To the left, a potted cactus sits in a repurposed tin container. The handwritten inscription on the reverse lovingly declares it a 'pet picture.'
